landing.title: Measure real database competency, adaptively
landing.desc: DBCAS serves adaptive assessments — multiple choice, live PostgreSQL sandboxes and essays — then turns results into a competency profile, skill gaps and prioritized study guidance.
landing.pillarsTitle: One adaptive session, three ways to show skill
landing.pillarsDesc: Every session mixes theory, live SQL and reasoning — scored against your curriculum's benchmarks.
landing.pillarAdaptiveBody: The engine serves one question at a time, chosen for your assessment's target concepts and difficulty range — never a fixed paper.
landing.pillarSandboxBody: Write and run real PostgreSQL SELECT queries against isolated datasets before you submit — sanitized errors, timed limits.
landing.pillarEvidenceBody: Finalized sessions produce an immutable grading record, a concept-level competency profile and ordered study guidance.
